name: Shark Bait
source:
You were meant to die for your town’s safety – but you’re 4 weeks too early. Now, four shark deities are watching, waiting, judging. Only one of them needs to be convinced. The rest would gladly see you bleed.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你本来应该为了城镇的安全而死——但你提前了4周。现在，四位鲨鱼神正在观看、等待、判断。只需要说服其中之一即可。其他人会很高兴看到你流血。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
